summary: Live swarm-control validation is now blocked by an immutable REVIEW_RESULT event whose already-published top-level review fields pr/headSha/verdict are rejected by main's current validate_event allowed-key schema. The immutable-event transition guard forbids rewriting or deleting that historical event, so recovery must make the validator compatibly accept and strictly validate the already-published structured fields rather than mutate history.
evidence: Swarm Control Plane run 31471357908 reached validate-control-branch after worker-status repairs and failed on .swarm/events/2026-08-11/evt-20260811-073650-q9m4r2-worldentity-sync-hold.json: unknown keys ['headSha', 'pr', 'verdict'].
Current main tools/swarm/swarmctl.py validate_event allows only laneId/severity/evidence/toWorker/metadata beyond the required event fields, so the published review fields fail closed.
Current main transition_check rejects any changed or deleted existing event bytes; editing the offending immutable event is therefore not a valid recovery.
PR #306 exact-head canonical CI is green but live ownership cannot execute semantically until control validation is restored.

metadata.recommendedRecovery: extend validate_event compatibly for immutable structured review fields with strict type/shape validation and regression coverage
